tools.description: Accept heartbeat result for post-turn handling. `notify=false` no visible send. `notify=true` needs concise notificationText. Scratch is monitor prose only.

scratch.description: Complete replacement for heartbeat monitor prose; not a recurring schedule.

tools.name: heartbeat_respond

tools.description: End this turn to await pending child completions, not submit a final result. Return completed work normally. Does not message other sessions; use sessions_send. Unfinished subagents awaiting an incoming continuation must set waitFor:"message". For background tools, follow their continuation instructions. Collector runs require agents_wait instead.

acknowledgment.description: Optional waiting reply in this session; with waitFor, text for an eligible task pause notice. Not an inter-session message.

message.description: Private context for the resumed turn; not sent to the user.

waitFor.description: Pause an unfinished subagent until an incoming continuation. Does not send or schedule that message or submit a final result.

tools.name: sessions_yield
